name: wildcard-permitted-far-inner-valid
description: A wildcard SAN deep inside the permitted subtree (*.bar.foo.example.com under foo.example.com) is accepted because every expansion stays inside the permitted subtree.
references: Go name_constraints_test "far inner wildcard names are matched by subdomain permitted constraints"
notes: RFC 5280 does not define wildcard SAN semantics; this targets Go's application DNS-ID name-constraint behavior.
